name: 端到端：F88 个人任务中心-任务状态&进度 / 通过率 与详情数据一致性校验
description: 在个人任务中心列表读取首个任务的进度文案与通过率，进入任务详情统计总/已完成/已通过数量，计算期望值并断言列表展示与详情数据一致；要求测试任务内至少4条审核数据。

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]')); const row = rows[0]; if (!row) return null; const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); const progressCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /进行|完成|待开始|\d\/\d/.test(c.innerText)); const passRateCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => /%|通过/.test(c.innerText)); const opCell = Array.from(cells).find(c => c.innerText.includes('查看详情')); const detailLink = opCell ? opCell.querySelector('a') : null; const href = detailLink?.getAttribute('href') || ''; const taskIdMatch = href.match(/[?&]taskId=([^&]+)/); return { taskName: cells[0]?.innerText?.trim(), progressText: progressCell?.innerText?.trim(), passRateText: passRateCell?.innerText?.trim(), detailHref: href, taskId: taskIdMatch ? taskIdMatch[1] : '', rowText: row.innerText }; })()
steps.description: 读取首行任务的进度与通过率
断言列表进度文案非空
断言列表通过率文案非空

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key], .audit-item, .material-item')); const total = rows.length; if (total === 0) return null; let completed = 0; let approved = 0; let rejected = 0; rows.forEach(r => { const text = r.innerText; if (text.includes('审核通过') || text.includes('已通过')) approved++; else if (text.includes('审核驳回') || text.includes('已驳回')) rejected++; if (text.includes('审核通过') || text.includes('审核驳回') || text.includes('已完成')) completed++; }); return { total, completed, approved, rejected }; })()
steps.description: 统计任务详情中素材总数/已完成/已通过/已驳回

steps.expression: (() => { const stats = JSON.parse('${store.detailStats}'); const list = JSON.parse('${store.listTask}'); const progressMatch = list.progressText.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/); const expectedCompleted = progressMatch ? parseInt(progressMatch[1]) : null; const expectedTotal = progressMatch ? parseInt(progressMatch[2]) : null; const passMatch = list.passRateText.match(/([\d.]+)%/); const expectedPassRate = passMatch ? parseFloat(passMatch[1]) : null; const computedPassRate = stats.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.approved / stats.total) * 1000) / 10 : 0; return { expectedCompleted, expectedTotal, expectedPassRate, computedCompleted: stats.completed, computedTotal: stats.total, computedPassRate, consistent: expectedCompleted === stats.completed && expectedTotal === stats.total && Math.abs(expectedPassRate - computedPassRate) < 0.1 }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心至少有一个含≥4条素材的任务。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 列表列：任务状态&进度（进行中/已完成/待开始 + 完成数/总数）、通过率；详情页可统计各状态素材数量。
riskPoints: 任务详情页DOM结构可能与预期不一致
通过率计算口径可能为 approved/completed 而非 approved/total
无任务或任务数据不足4条时无法验证
API字段名（totalCount/passCount）为示例，需按真实接口调整
